title: Debt Shield
summary: Ketch ordered second-hand gyro parts off a Reclaimer trader camped outside the east gate — cheap, questionably obtained, exactly what the Wren needs. Fetch the parts, bring them home, get your first taste of garage credit.

objectives.label: Collect the gyro crate from the trader camp at the east gate
Haul the parts back to Ketch's garage

offer.text: Good news, kid. I found gyro rings for the Wren at a price that only makes me mildly suspicious. Bad news: the seller's a Reclaimer, camped at the east gate, and she doesn't do house calls.
Fetch the crate and I'll knock labour off your tab. Not the debt — the Guild owns that like it owns the concept of rain. My labour. That's mine to forgive.

accept.text: Trader's name's Brinn. Rust colours, big laugh, honest-ish scales. If she offers you a deal on a 'slightly warm' horizon cell, the answer is no, and the answer was always no.
East gate, gyro crate, no warm batteries. Anything else I should be warned about that you'll tell me afterwards?
The crate's heavier than it looks. Gyro rings always are. It's the spin they're saving up.

complete.text: That's the stuff. Second-hand, third-hand if we're honest — but these rings outlived the company that made them, and that company outlived the money. Good bones.
She tried to sell me a horizon cell that was 'only a little warm'.
I have a debt, Ketch, not a death wish.
Ha! You'll do, kid. While I'm under the Wren this week, ask me anything — garage advice is free, which, between us, is the correct price for it.
